title: Mixed affine unit comparison is invertible on K-flat chart models
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with independent sheaf and module derived localization universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $P$ be a K-flat cochain complex of $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let $Q$ be the localization of termwise $\widetilde P$, restricted from $\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ to $S$ along its canonical spectrum isomorphism [lem-pc-affine-module-complex-representative]. The transpose under the fixed scalar extension/restriction adjunction [lem-sc-mixed-global-extension-adjunction] of $R\Gamma_S(\eta_g(Q))$ followed by normalized Leray [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso] is invertible. Here $\eta_g$ is the unit of the fixed sheaf pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction]. No boundedness or flatness of $g$ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06Z0 and 08DW(2); cohomology.tex Tags 08HY and 0D5T; duality.tex Tag 0AA8, identification of beta

proof.text: Use the proved ordinary affine chart extension/sections comparison to obtain the natural isomorphism c with its fixed ordinary adjunction unit equation. This works on the actual canonical Gamma(S)-chart functor, for arbitrary affine S and T.

Apply the mixed chart model localization factorization to c.hom and its unit equation, with the additive instances for chart tilde, ordinary sections, extension and tensor pullback. Obtain the source and target isomorphisms a,b and n b.hom = a.hom Q(c_P).

The termwise map c_P is the hom of NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex c, so it is invertible. Localization Q preserves its invertibility. The right hand side a.hom Q(c_P) is invertible. Since b.hom is invertible, IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right applied to the factorization gives that n is invertible. The original nested termwise-chart model is definitionally the complex map of the composite chart functor, so this proves the original statement unchanged.

The extension restriction adjunction mate of global sections of the derived pullback unit is invertible for the associated sheaf of a K flat module complex
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including underived SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_symm_unitToPushforwardObjUnit and pushforwardSections_unitHomEquiv. No derived affine K-flat model mate.

Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Basic supplies naturality; Unique supplies leftAdjointUniq and its unit equation. No affine derived theorem. Direct project rg found AffineExtensionSectionsModelMate, which uses equal localization universes, spectrum bases and affine base-ring actions. Its signature cannot directly state the present mixed-universe Gamma-ring chart computation.

theorem mixedAffineSections_kFlat_comparison_isIso
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsAffine T]
    (g : T ⟶ S) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P) :
    let Q := DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(S, ⊤)).toRingedSpace) ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ))
          (by change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ).PreservesZeroMorphisms
              infer_instance) (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
              (@id (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤) ⥤
                SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(S, ⊤)).toRingedSpace))
                (tilde.functor Γ(S, ⊤))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    IsIso (((mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).map ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app Q) ≫
        (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj Q)))
